faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Accounting Assistant post at IIM Kozhikode?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Accounting Assistant position at IIM Kozhikode is 12th October 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Accounting Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed the First group of CA Intermediate with articleship or possess a B. Com degree with three years of relevant work experience. Proficiency in MS-Excel and MS-Word is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Accounting Assistant post is 40 years. Age relaxations will be provided as per the Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Junior Accounting Assistant position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Accounting Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Accounting Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 24,300/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Accounting Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Accounting Assistant post at the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Accounting Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job? Is it permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Accounting Assistant position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Kozhikode located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode is located in Kozhikode, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions, so candidates from other states can apply if they meet the eligibility criteria.
